scope: Simulation, measured RGB-D only, no VLM evaluation
identity_prior: Observed colored magnetic adaptors and placement markings; no object count supplied
endpoint: All scene objects placed and withdrawn; independent geometry, payload containment, placement, reaction, C2-rest and recording-clock audits pass
denominator: All 120 predeclared seeds per mode, including generation, commissioning, planning, sensing, timeout and audit failures
admission: No visibility, IK or task-success filtering; bounded geometric placement only
statistical_reporting: Report completion fractions and 95% Wilson intervals overall and separately for both shape families; no claim population rate >90% from point estimate alone
